headline_html:
1.4.0 — Float16 and int8 storage

Core, PyPI, and npm logosdb at 1.4.0. Node and Python constructors accept an optional dtype (DTYPE_FLOAT32, DTYPE_FLOAT16, DTYPE_INT8) to store vectors at half or quarter size on disk (#139). Default remains float32. Search still uses float32 internally. Reopening with the wrong dtype fails with a clear error.
